userDecisions.U1: Split tied relay points: sum the tied places and divide (e.g. 1st+2nd tied -> (40+34)/2 each). Swim-offs for final spots are out of scope.

userDecisions.U3: Back up data/omniswim.db, list the 39 "UI ..." workspaces, delete only those via the app delete route. Do not kill the port-3000 server.
userDecisions.U4: Add relay programs only from a published, archived source; leave the rest absent; make relays-before-individual order a visible setting.
userDecisions.U5: Seed place-point tables empty; core returns null past the table end; a blank cell blocks save.
userDecisions.U6: Restore one-click All teams apply AND add a visible remove button (keep Delete/Backspace).
userDecisions.U7: Season trend shows the workspace own team by default, with a team picker; team absent from a meet gets no point.
userDecisions.U8: git rm --cached the three roster .txt files, add to .gitignore, keep local copies. History is not rewritten.
userDecisions.U10: Rely on P3 version checks; do not persist save-sequence numbers.
userDecisions.U11: Invite-only registration when AUTH_REQUIRED, 12-character minimum, plus rate limit, generic register error, Secure cookie off loopback.
userDecisions.U12: User authorizes the agent to capture live SwimCloud pages through the Claude in Chrome extension, in its own tab group, using the user real Chrome sign-in. Pace human-like, only the named pages, never commit captures. Supersedes the plan rule "No agent contacts swimcloud.com".
userDecisions.D9: Time trials do not fill relay legs by default; an opt-in setting allows it and any such leg is labelled.
userDecisions.meetsJson: data/meets.json stays live private state; tests that need data use data/demo-seed.json.

userDecisions.secondUser: A mix of another coach (knows swimming, not the tool) and an athlete/staff member (less scoring depth). Explain the app and key terms inline; keep copy plain.
